title: Interventional Training Reduces Causal Bypass in In-Context Introspection
summary: Straight SFT can achieve endogenous signal-reporting performance while failing interventional checks; counterfactual intervention training improves causal introspection, especially OOD. Models are trained to introspect neuron, attention and sparse-autoencoder signals; intervention training uses counterfactually perturbed signals. Testing: Hundreds of introspectors across eight language models and three signal types are compared under endogenous and intervened/OOD conditions; generalization to unseen sites is limited.. Hundreds of introspectors across eight language models and three signal types are compared under endogenous and intervened/OOD conditions; generalization to unseen sites is limited.
